# acecloud_snapshot (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud volume snapshot.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot. Must be alphanumeric with hyphens.
- `volume_id` (String) ID of the volume to create the snapshot from.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the snapshot.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the snapshot was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the snapshot.
- `size` (Number) Size of the snapshot in GB.
- `status` (String) Current status of the snapshot (e.g. available, creating).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the snapshot was last updated.
